author: Mark Atwood
text: DEPENDENCY UPDATE 2026-05-12 (cascade from PKIX-jy95.6 = A): this bead now depends on the pkix-zlint-bridge and pkix-pkilint-bridge crates (PKIX-jy95.7 and .8) rather than implementing its own subprocess plumbing. The differential oracles for pkix-difftest call into the bridge crates for 'run zlint on this cert, give me parsed findings' / same for pkilint, then handle the verdict-reconciliation logic locally. Architectural rationale: PKIX-jy95.6 ratified shared public bridge crates as the right shape for this functionality. The bridge plumbing is identical between runtime adapter and differential oracle use cases; sharing prevents drift. Out of scope changes here: oracle implementation timing now wants to lag bridge crate readiness (PKIX-jy95.7 ships first, then this oracle work consumes it). Re-evaluate sequencing when PKIX-jy95.7 implementation starts.
